findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-wrapt
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution using " + call.getFunction().toString() + " that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection through eval(), exec(), or compile() with potentially untrusted input

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution using ControlFlowNode for exec that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe dynamic import
 * @description Dynamic imports with user-controlled module names can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-dynamic-import
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("import_module").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("__import__").getACall()
  )
select call, "Dynamic import operation that could load arbitrary modules."
findings.hypothesis: Detecting unsafe dynamic imports using __import__ or importlib that could load arbitrary modules
